title: [BUG] OpenAIModel (Responses, TypeScript) drops prompt cache tokens (cached_tokens not plumbed to cacheReadInputTokens)
body:
### Checks

- [x] I have updated to the latest minor and patch version of Strands
- [x] I have checked the documentation and this is not expected behavior
- [x] I have searched ./issues and there are no duplicates of my issue

### SDK Language

TypeScript

### Strands Version

strands-ts (typescript/v1.5.0; reproduced on `main` @ a92502f)

### Language Runtime Version

Node.js 22

### Summary

The TypeScript `OpenAIModel` Responses adapter does not propagate OpenAI prompt-cache usage. The Responses API returns `usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens`, but the adapter's stream-state usage mapping only reads `input_tokens` / `output_tokens` / `total_tokens`. As a result `cacheReadInputTokens` is never set on the emitted `modelMetadataEvent`, and downstream telemetry (`gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens`, set in `telemetry/tracer.ts` only when `cacheReadInputTokens` is present) never reflects cache reads for the Responses path.

This is the TypeScript counterpart of the Python issue #2407 (PR #2663). Those only touch `strands-py/src/strands/models/openai_responses.py`; the TS adapter was not updated and there is no existing TS issue/PR for it.

It is also an asymmetry within strands-ts itself: `models/bedrock.ts` (L1524-1528), `models/anthropic.ts` (L175-178), and `models/vercel.ts` (L350-351) all plumb `cacheReadInputTokens` / `cacheWriteInputTokens` into usage. The `Usage` type already declares both fields (`models/streaming.ts` L513/L519) and the accumulator already sums them (L548-552), so the type surface is ready — only the Responses adapter doesn't fill it.

Note: the **write side already works** — `formatResponsesRequest` spreads `...(config.params ?? {})` into the request body (`models/openai/responses-adapter.ts` L66), and the OpenAI SDK types already include `prompt_cache_key` / `prompt_cache_retention` on `ResponseCreateParams`. So a caller can already enable caching; this issue is specifically that the resulting **cache reads are invisible** in usage/metrics.

### Affected code

`strands-ts/src/models/openai/responses-adapter.ts`:

- `ResponsesStreamState.finalUsage` is typed as `{ inputTokens; outputTokens; totalTokens } | null` (L334) — no cache fields.
- `mapResponsesEventToSDK`, the `response.completed` and `response.incomplete` branches (L466-486), build `finalUsage` from `resp.usage.input_tokens` / `output_tokens` / `total_tokens` only; `resp.usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens` is dropped.
- `finalizeResponsesStream` then emits `{ type: 'modelMetadataEvent', usage: state.finalUsage }` (L530), so the cache read count never reaches the SDK usage.

OpenAI SDK already types the field: `ResponseUsage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens: number` (`openai/resources/responses/responses.d.ts`).

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Use `OpenAIModel({ api: 'responses' })` against an endpoint that supports Responses prompt caching (e.g. OpenAI, or GPT-5.x via Bedrock Mantle), with `params: { prompt_cache_key: 'stable-key', prompt_cache_retention: '24h' }` and a >1k-token prefix.
2. Send the same prefix twice (allow propagation) so the second call is a cache hit — the raw `response.completed` event carries `usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens > 0`.
3. Inspect `AgentResult.metrics.accumulated_usage` (or the OTel span).

### Expected Behavior

`cacheReadInputTokens` reflects `usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens`, matching the Bedrock / Anthropic / Vercel adapters and the Python Responses fix (#2663). OTel `gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens` is populated.

### Actual Behavior

`cacheReadInputTokens` is always undefined for the Responses path; cache savings are invisible in metrics and telemetry even though the API is returning `cached_tokens`.

linked_prs.title: fix(openai): report Responses prompt-cache tokens (TypeScript)
